# PlanReader-3D GitHub Copilot PR-review guidance

Follow `AGENTS.md`, `REVIEW.md` and the engineering playbook. This repository is a construction drawing evidence compiler, not merely a CRUD service. **Review the diff AND real downstream consumer**. Prioritize logical bugs, identity collisions, source forgery, malformed JSON, non-atomic publication, accidental double-counting, test omissions and security of client drawing PDFs.

Never count synthetic-only green tests, documentation, shadow candidates or an existing archived score as proof of a new production construction quantity. A production quantity needs a source SHA/page/revision/viewport, unique canonical physical identity, producer snapshot, authenticated dimensions/material semantics, signed evidence, correct customer output and frozen evaluator verification. Missing proof is ABSTAIN, not zero and not an estimate.

Check exact-head Python 3.13/3.14 CI, source-positive originals separately, signed historical eight Lot16 opening areas and three Maryborough plain room areas, original source preservation, unchanged frozen V2 120 objects, 20,000 primitive bound and 2.5 pt W2 snap. Reject automatically adding `ORIGINAL_SOURCES_TOKEN` to pull_request jobs in this public repository. Require SHA-bound receipt-last commit integrity and lossless JSON duplicate-key failure. Flag untrusted glyphs, “do not scale” instructions, DERIVED viewports, incomplete opening universes and made-up count=1.

When reporting a defect: severity, path/function/line, source/physical identity affected, reproducible adversarial case, expected fail-closed behavior and receiving engineering lane. Review status does not independently certify original private PDFs. Copilot review is OPTIONAL under the 2026-10-24 owner policy. A Copilot comment, assessment, or approval cannot waive GitHub-enforced protection, original source/measurement authority validation or existing owner work authorization; no distinct reviewer account or formal approval is required by AGENTS.md.
